title: Mine or Yours
description: Filnjar, the blacksmith of Shor's Stone, reports that Redbelly Mine is overrun with frostbite spiders and asks for help clearing them out to restore the town's ebony mining operation.

base_facts: I am the blacksmith of Shor's Stone.
Redbelly Mine is our main source of income, producing ebony ore.
The mine gets its name from the red sulfurous mist that fills the caverns.

HEAR_ABOUT_MINE: Frostbite spiders have overrun Redbelly Mine and it is no longer producing.
The town guards will not help with the spider problem; they are too busy watching for enemy soldiers.
ACCEPT_QUEST: Someone has agreed to clear the spiders from Redbelly Mine for me.
SPIDERS_CLEARED: The frostbite spiders in Redbelly Mine have been killed, clearing the way for ebony mining to resume.
Redbelly Mine can now produce ebony ore again, putting Shor's Stone back on the map.
Filnjar needs to be informed of the good news and will reward leveled gold for reopening the mine.
Filnjar's disposition will increase by one once he learns the spiders are gone.
RETURN_TO_FILNJAR: The mine is clear and Shor's Stone is back on the map. I rewarded my helper with leveled gold.

beats.comment: Player learns about the spider infestation in Redbelly Mine from Filnjar.
Player agrees to clear the mine of spiders, starting the quest at stage 20.
Observation that all frostbite spiders in Redbelly Mine have been killed, advancing to stage 30.
Player returns to Filnjar and reports the mine is clear, completing the quest at stage 200.
